items.title: U.S. Bancorp (USB) Taps Calvert Lange To Lead Institutional Payments
items.summary: U.S. Bancorp (NYSE:USB) appointed Calvert Lange as Senior Vice President and Head of Payments: Merchant and Institutional Sales Group. Lange will oversee payments and treasury management coverage for technology, transportation, consumer, and hospitality sector clients. She joins U.S. Bancorp after previous senior roles at Citi and Deutsche Bank focused on institutional payments and cash management. items.title: SoFi Becomes First U.S. Bank to Settle Card Payments on Stablecoin
items.summary: SoFi Technologies  started settling card transactions using its own stablecoin on Tuesday, a program the company says is the first of its kind for a U.S. bank.  All debit- and credit-card transactions will be settled using  SoFi  USD, its dollar-backed stablecoin, over  Mastercard  payments network, SoFi said.  The company said the shift will showcase how bank-issued stablecoins—a type of cryptocurrency pegged to the U.S. dollar and backed by assets like bank deposits or Treasury bills—can coexist with existing payment infrastructure by “helping bridge traditional financial systems and blockchain-based networks.”
